traditional: 唔係 A 就係 B
jyutping: m4 hai6 A zau6 hai6 B

english.note: Use this when asserting that one of two alternatives must be the case, often with an emphatic or exclusive tone.

examples.english: Either they’re busy, or they’re feeling unwell.
examples.traditional: 唔係佢哋唔得閒，就係佢哋唔舒服。
examples.jyutping: m4 hai6 keoi5 dei6 m4 dak1 haan4 zau6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 m4 syu1 fuk6
